title: Ahrefs Pricing: How to Choose the Right Ahrefs Plan
snippet:
All products in Ahrefs can be broken down in the following list:
- **Free plan** - allows free-forever, limited access to our core tools*
- **Paid subscription plans** - allows access to our core tools, with higher plans giving access to more limits and advanced features
- **Optional Add-ons** - extend limits on existing plans or tools
- **Standalone tools** - access specific tools beyond our flagship ones (don’t require an Ahrefs plan)

## Ahrefs’ free plan
**Price: Free**
**Best for**: Website owners looking for simple tools to manage their website, but aren’t ready to pay for marketing tools just yet.
This plan allows you to use 6 of our powerful tools for free anytime, for an unlimited number of verified projects (websites you can prove ownership of):
1. Analyze website traffic and visitors in real-time with **[Web Analytics](https://ahrefs.com/web-analytics)**
2. View your top performing pages, keywords, and backlinks in **[Site Explorer](https://ahrefs.com/site-explorer)**
3. Audit your technical health for 170+ on-page & technical SEO issues with **[Site Audit](https://ahrefs.com/site-audit)**
4. Plan, schedule, and monitor social media posts with **[Social Media Manager](https://ahrefs.com/social-media-manager)**
5. Create intent optimized content with **[AI Content Helper](https://ahrefs.com/ai-content-helper)**
6. Access SEO metrics in SERPs and any page in your browser with [**SEO Toolbar**](https://ahrefs.com/seo-toolbar)
An example of crucial website data you can view without paying a single cent is backlinks for your website. You can filter by 100+ page types to surface authoritative referrers of your brand, and what drives relevant mentions of it.
#### Limits
- Web Analytics: 1million events
- Site Audit: 5,000 crawl credits per verified project per month
- Site Explorer: 1000 keywords, backlinks, or top pages at once
- Social Media Manager: Unlimited channels and posts (while in beta)
- AI Content Helper: 1 document/month

**Pricing:**
- Basic: 2,500 checks/mo ($50/mo, Overage $0.020/check/mo)
- Growth: 7,000 checks/mo ($100/mo, Overage $0.015/check/mo)
- Scale: 25,000 checks/mo ($250/mo, Overage $0.010/check/mo)

title: Introduction | Ahrefs for Developers
snippet:
Ahrefs API is available on [eligible paid plans](https://ahrefs.com/pricing). On all other plans, you'll still have access to a [limited set of free test queries](/en/api/docs/free-test-queries).
## Plan limits
All requests besides [free test queries](/en/api/docs/free-test-queries) and the *Rank Tracker*, *Management*, *Public* and *some other* endpoints consume **API units**. The cost depends on the number of rows in a response and the fields requested. The minimum cost for any request is **50 units**. If an endpoint is free, you'll see a note about that on its documentation page; otherwise, it consumes units.
Related guide: [Limits consumption](/en/api/docs/limits-consumption)
info
Please be advised that API units once consumed are non-refundable. We strongly encourage the use of our [complimentary test queries](/en/api/docs/free-test-queries) for all development and testing purposes to mitigate any unintended usage of API units.
We also recommend [putting limits](/en/api/docs/api-keys-creation-and-management) on your API keys, especially when you are in the testing and development stage.
[Eligible paid plans](https://ahrefs.com/pricing) include a monthly API unit allowance. On plans that support pay-as-you-go usage, additional units are automatically charged once the included limit is exceeded.
See also: [Pricing page](https://ahrefs.com/pricing) and [Account settings / Limits & usage](https://app.ahrefs.com/account/limits-and-usage/web).

title: Free test queries | Ahrefs for Developers
snippet:
Users on any paid plan can test Ahrefs API by running a limited set of free test queries. Note that you still need to [create an API key](/en/api/docs/api-keys-creation-and-management) to run free test queries.
## Site Explorer
For Site Explorer endpoints, requests will not consume API units if you use the `ahrefs.com`, `yep.com` or `firehose.com` domains, or any URL from these domains, in the `target` query parameter.

The `limit` parameter is capped at 100 in free test requests. Even if you request more, the response will contain 100 results max.
